title: Orchestrator review is mandatory and done by the orchestrator, not a reviewer agent
what: In orchestrator mode, task_done is refused until the orchestrator reads `review_packet` and calls `review_approve`. The approval is bound to the blake3 scope_key of the task's review_files (files_touched plus pending edits), so any later edit voids it.
why: The user trusts the orchestrator and rejected a separate reviewer subagent at about 20k tokens per review. A packet costs about 1–2k tokens per executor step (about 4.5k for 20 files) and makes the review step impossible to skip.
where: crates/anvil-core/src/review_gate.rs, review_gate/packet.rs; crates/anvil-tasks/src/review.rs; gates in CLI tasks Done and MCP handle_task_done
learned: review_files leaves out files changed before the task started, so a file created before task_start is not in the packet unless it is recorded with task_update files. Start the task before the first edit.
author: reactive-end
